metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) - "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - Date: April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019 (these are very close dates, monthly data may not capture this) - Actually, for such a short period (5 days), I need DAILY nighttime data - VIIRS DNB has monthly composites, not daily. Need to use "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VCMSLCFG" or similar - Let me check: There's no daily VIIRS in GEE catalog for such precise dates. The best available is monthly. - Since April 30 and May 5 are in different months (April vs May), I can compare April 2019 vs May 2019 monthly composites - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" - Locations: Biju Patnaik Airport (need to look up coords - it's in Bhubaneswar, Odisha) vs Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) - Biju Patnaik Airport coords: approximately 20.244, 85.817 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we typically don't need cloud masking as the monthly composites already filter out clouds - Use the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) 3. Logic: - Calculate mean brightness for April 2019 and May 2019 at both locations - Calculate decrease at each location: April_value - May_value - Compare: if Airport_decrease > Saheed_Nagar_decrease, answer A; else B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const airport = ee.Geometry.Point([85.817, 20.244]); // Biju Patnaik Airport, Bhubaneswar const saheedNagar = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813]); const aprilStart = '2019-04-01'; const aprilEnd = '2019-04-30'; const mayStart = '2019-05-01'; const mayEnd = '2019-05-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'); const aprilCol = viirs.filterDate(aprilStart, aprilEnd); const mayCol = viirs.filterDate(mayStart, mayEnd); const aprilSize = aprilCol.size().getInfo(); const maySize = mayCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`April 2019 Images: ${aprilSize}`); console.log(`May 2019 Images: ${maySize}`); if (aprilSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { console.log('No data for one or both months.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Get monthly composites const aprilImg = aprilCol.first(); const mayImg = mayCol.first(); const band = 'avg_rad'; // 4. Calculate brightness at both locations for both months const aprilAirport = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: airport, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); const mayAirport = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: airport, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); const aprilSaheed = aprilImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: saheedNagar, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); const maySaheed = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: saheedNagar, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get(band).getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (aprilAirport === null || mayAirport === null || aprilSaheed === null || maySaheed === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values returned.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Airport - April: ${aprilAirport.toFixed(4)}, May: ${mayAirport.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Saheed Nagar - April: ${aprilSaheed.toFixed(4)}, May: ${maySaheed.toFixed(4)}`); const airportDecrease = aprilAirport - mayAirport; const saheedDecrease = aprilSaheed - maySaheed; console.log(`Airport decrease: ${airportDecrease.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Saheed Nagar decrease: ${saheedDecrease.toFixed(4)}`); if (airportDecrease > saheedDecrease) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
